text:
alex: Heads-up — we keep seeing small spikes in queue depth across eu-west during deploy windows. Not full saturation but visibility is awful in the rollup panels.
maria: Seen it. The rollup is averaging across pools so short bursts get smoothed out. We lose batch-size correlation.
jin: Can you point to the panel? I only checked the per-pool heatmap and that looked fine.
alex: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/queue-rollup?panelId=7 — the top row is the rollup. Notice the 2-3m blips at 05:12 and 05:25.
owen: Those blips correlate with small bursts from canary traffic — they increase batch wait by ~30ms. Not visible in the global SLO chart though.
maria: I think we need a secondary panel that shows distribution percentiles (p50/p95/p99) for queue_depth and batch_wait per pool rather than a mean.
jin: Agree. Also add an instantaneous max-time series so we don't only see 5m rate averages.
alex: Proposed PromQL snippets I tried locally: ```
// per-pool p95 queue depth over 5m
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(queue_depth_bucket[5m])) by (le, pool))

// instantaneous max queue depth (last sample)
max by(pool) (queue_depth)
```
maria: Nice. For batching, this helps: ```
// average batch wait & batch size p90
avg_over_time(batch_wait_seconds[1m]) by (pool)
histogram_quantile(0.90, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket[2m])) by (le, pool))
```
jin: Two operational asks: 1) add those to the rollup row but keep a small-card layout; 2) create an alert that fires if queue p95 > 25 for 3m AND batch_wait p95 > 0.2s — we don't want noisy alerts from single-sample spikes.
owen: Can we also tag panels with pool labels for dedicated vs shared? That will help cost owners correlate to reservation usage.
alex: Good call. Also thinking of a compact histogram sparkline per pool showing batch_size distribution for last 15m. Grafana supports sparklines in table cells.
maria: I'll make a draft dashboard and push to the ops team board. If folks can review, I'll open a PR.
jin: Quick note on alert noise — use for: 5m but require both metrics to be bad. Use annotations to show deploy times so we can tune.
deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/rollup-dashboard update by maria at 1718500050 :rocket:
alex: Thanks. When you open the PR, include before/after screenshots and the PromQL for reviewers. Also include the chart that shows how smoothing window (1m vs 5m avg) affects blip visibility.
maria: Will do. PR in a few mins. :thumbsup: 
jen: (typo — meant jin)
jin: all good :)
